column1: # delcarretto1576 - the frozen key K_T of key.tsv written with the sign groups as they stand in transcription.txt, so that
# the key can be applied to the transcription by longest match without the renaming step. Added 16 Nov 2026 (decrypt audit).
# No new value. Source of the four group rows: key.tsv header and rows 1, 2, 3 ("Tokens 1, 2, 3 are the groups oPo, oP,
# oPo./oP.") and transcription.txt header ("Tokenisation used by the key: 'oPo.' and 'oP.' -> 3 ; 'oPo' -> 1 ; 'oP' -> 2").
# All other rows are copied from key.tsv unchanged (the isolated o keeps its key value i; reading.md treats it as a null).
# key.tsv itself is untouched and remains the frozen key.
